messages.text: @AmazonHelp My order 112-9847291-098234 has not arrived yet and it was supposed to be delivered yesterday.
@cust_1 We are sorry to hear that! Please send us a DM with your tracking number so we can check the status.
@AmazonHelp Sent the DM! Please look into it ASAP.
@cust_1 Thanks for providing details. We have updated your shipment and it is out for delivery today.
@AmazonHelp I was charged twice for my Prime membership this month. Can I get a refund for the extra charge?
@cust_2 Apologies for the trouble! Please DM us your account email so we can verify the duplicate charge and process a refund.
@cust_2 DM sent. Hope it gets resolved soon.
@cust_2 We have verified the duplicate billing and issued a full refund of $14.99. It will reflect in 3-5 business days.
@AmazonHelp How do I update my default delivery address on my account?
@cust_14 Go to Your Account > Your Addresses to add, edit, or set default delivery addresses.
